Add multiple legitimate bookstore fallbacks to reference links

## Summary
Enhanced the LLM enrichment service to generate multiple legitimate bookstore links as fallbacks. Now books with missing Amazon links will display links to Open Library (free), Goodreads, Bookshop.org (indie bookstores), and Google Books instead of Google Drive URLs.

## Cost-Effective Solution
- **Open Library** (openlibrary.org): Free, non-profit, always available
- **Goodreads**: Free book information platform, popular with readers
- **Bookshop.org**: Supports independent bookstores, competitive pricing
- **Google Books**: Preview access, library catalog integration
- **Amazon**: Primary purchase link when available

## Changes Made

### Backend Improvements (`llmEnrichmentService.js`)
- **Enhanced LLM Prompt**: Added multiple bookstore platforms with examples and priority guidelines
- **Comprehensive Fallback Generation**: Now generates all 4 alternative links for every book
- **Article Support**: Added Google Scholar fallback for articles without journal links

### Frontend Improvements (`references.js`)
- **Smart Link Prioritization**: Books display in order: Amazon → Publisher → Bookshop.org → Open Library → Google Books → Goodreads
- **Zero Google Drive URLs**: Completely eliminates Google Drive fallback for books
- **Multiple Options**: Users can choose their preferred platform for accessing book information

## Results
All books now have legitimate public access links:
- No Google Drive URLs shown to users
- Every book has at least 3-4 alternative access methods
- Users can choose between purchase (Amazon), indie support (Bookshop.org), free access (Open Library), or information (Goodreads)
- Articles and videos show actual source links or Google Scholar

## Testing
Verified with sample books:
- "Warren Buffett Accounting Book": Now shows Open Library + Goodreads + Bookshop.org (was Google Drive)
- "Et si vous en saviez assez...": Now shows Open Library + Goodreads + Bookshop.org (was Google Drive)
- "Freakonomics": Shows Amazon + Open Library + Goodreads + Bookshop.org
- All other books properly enriched with multiple access options
